records.text: I am against private court processes because secrecy lets parties harass opponents and get away with more than in public proceedings.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And that's also why I am against all of these now court processes that you can agree to, like I had agreed to with The Daily Wire. ... actually it just allows them to just harass you and then get away with more when it's not public and when things are public the public can look in and they can see exactly what's going on
